audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read 'Skill' though whys[0] and early both say Maokai out-sustains and can root you before you own a dash; Levels 4-5 and Level 6 read 'Skill' though the whys say stacked tentacles out-damage him 'decisively' and your R field 'overwhelms him'; 2+ items read Illaoi though whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say tank Maokai shrugs the tentacles off.
audit.why: Packet chart is Maokai, Illaoi x5, Maokai; 52.2% over 569 games matches a lane lost at level 1, owned through items, then lost to tank scaling.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Maokai, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 -> Illaoi, 2+ items -> Maokai, both layers, ratings moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twisted Advance carried no cooldown anywhere despite the whole trading section being keyed to it, and Sapling Toss had no numbers at all.
audit.why: Twisted Advance is 14/13/12/11/10s, Sapling Toss 18/17/16/15/14s at 1100 range, Bramble Smash 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s, Nature's Grasp 130/110/90s. Your Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1, so at level 3 his root is back before your grab is.
audit.corrected: Twisted Advance's 14s in the do's, Sapling Toss's 18s and 1100 range in the don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] said Maokai wants to 'use W root to break your E tether' — two errors at once. Twisted Advance dashes him TOWARD his target, so it cannot carry him away from anything, and leaving the spirit is what turns him into a Vessel. wants.foe[0] also credited the saplings to his passive; saplings are Sapling Toss (E). Sap Magic's real mechanic — the heal cooldown dropping every time a spell hits him — was never stated, and the W's untargetability was absent.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target'; 'Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.' The second line is the reason anti-heal is core here — your own tentacle field accelerates his sustain.
audit.corrected: Twisted Advance restated as an inbound dash with mid-dash untargetability; Sap Magic's spell-driven heal named as the anti-heal reason; saplings attributed to E.

edits.before: With W (Harsh Lesson) up you dash through his saplings and land E (Test of Spirit); Maokai's only disruption is W (Twisted Advance) root, and if he burns it to break tether you still get the swarm.
edits.after: With Harsh Lesson up you dash through his saplings and land Test of Spirit; Twisted Advance dashes him TOWARD you and roots, so it cannot break the leash — and leaving the spirit makes him a Vessel anyway.

edits.before: Poke and sustain with passive saplings and W root
edits.after: Poke with Sapling Toss and heal off Sap Magic

edits.before: Use W (Twisted Advance) root to break your E tether
edits.after: Root you with Twisted Advance, then kill the spirit

edits.before: His lock-on root. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is 14s at rank 1 and he is untargetable mid-dash.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Sapling Toss is 1100 range and hits harder in brush — 18s at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Maokai's Twisted Advance (Root): His lock-on root. Dodge it. When it is down — Slam him in your field.
edits.after: Sap Magic's heal speeds up each time a spell hits him — your tentacles feed it, so buy anti-heal early.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the slow makes tentacles land), then Sterak's Gage; boots Mercury's Treads. Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the slow makes tentacles land), then Sterak's Gage; boots Mercury's Treads. Executioner's Calling early — Sap Magic heals off every spell hit.

notes: The Sap Magic interaction is unusually important here and was missing entirely: every tentacle slam that connects shortens his heal cooldown, so an extended brawl without Grievous Wounds feeds him. Also note his W grants untargetability during the dash — timed burst thrown at the cast whiffs. No question blocked this matchup.
